newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London dip in thin market.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London dip in thin market.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were mixed to lower in thin trade as most participants remained absent due to the Christmas and New Year's holidays, dealers said.
"The market is really not doing much of anything. There are very few people around," one dealer said.
In Hong Kong on Monday, the Hang Seng index ended 76.62 points higher at 13,480.75. The Hang Seng will be open for just a half-day session on Tuesday ahead of the New Year break.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was down 15.17 points at 13,465.58 by 1225 GMT.
